title: Business Hours
text: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM IST. On Sundays and public holidays we run a reduced on-call team for urgent issues only.

title: Pricing Plans
text: We offer three plans: Starter (free, up to 100 requests/month), Growth (₹2,999/month, up to 10,000 requests, priority support), and Enterprise (custom pricing, dedicated infrastructure, SLA-backed uptime).

title: Refund Policy
text: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase if usage is under 10% of the plan quota. Refund requests are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

title: Onboarding Process
text: New customers get a dedicated onboarding call within 48 hours of sign-up, sample integration code, and a sandbox API key valid for 30 days before production keys are issued.

title: Data Privacy
text: All customer data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). We do not share data with third parties and support data deletion requests within 30 days.
